items.title: Bose Unveils Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) With Cinema Mode and 9-Hour Battery
items.summary: Bose announced the second-generation Ultra Open Earbuds on September 17, adding a redesigned driver with deeper bass, Cinema Mode powered by TrueSpatial, Bluetooth 5.4 with aptX Adaptive and wireless charging. Priced at $299, the open-ear clip-style earbuds arrive October 1 with up to 9 hours of playback per charge.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: Smaller Shell, Class-Leading Transparency and Best Android Codec Support
items.summary: The Review Bench finds the WF-1000XM6 deliver the best transparency mode in their class and best-in-class Android codec support including LDAC, LC3 and Auracast, with a shell about 12 percent smaller than the XM5 for a secure fit. Touch controls remain a weakness, but they are the default pick for Android-first buyers at $299.

items.title: OPPO Enco X4 Teased Ahead of September 22 Global Launch With Dynaudio Tuning and AI Translation
items.summary: Oppo revealed the Enco X4 true wireless earbuds ahead of their September 22 global debut, showing a stemmed design in three finishes and an oval charging case. The earbuds use a fourth-generation Dynaudio co-developed dual driver, a 6nm chip with AI noise cancellation, lossless audio transmission and two-way AI real-time translation.

items.title: vivo Launches Buds Clip Open-Ear Earbuds With 42-Hour Battery Life
items.summary: vivo launched the Buds Clip, its first clip-style open-ear earbuds, on September 21 alongside the X500 series. Each 5.2g bud uses a flexible titanium alloy bridge, a 12mm driver with Hi-Res and LDAC, three-device connection, bone-conduction AI call reduction and up to 42 hours total battery life, priced from 699 yuan.

items.title: Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition Debuts in India at 6,999 Rupees
items.summary: Realme launched the Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition in India on September 21 alongside the Realme 16 Pro 5G. The Hogwarts-themed true wireless earbuds keep the standard model's specs: 12.4mm drivers, 50dB ANC, Hi-Res audio, Bluetooth 6.1 and 56 hours total playback, with sales starting September 22.

items.title: Omdia: Global TWS Shipments Fall 0.7% in Q2 2026 as Open-Ear Models Grow 12%
items.summary: Omdia reports worldwide true wireless earbuds shipments dropped 0.7 percent year over year to 82.1 million units in Q2 2026, the first annual decline since 2023, while open wireless stereo (OWS) grew 12 percent to 11.1 million. Apple led with a 20.5 percent share on 16.8 million units, and Omdia expects OWS to reach 90.5 million by 2030.

items.title: CMF Clip Pro Open-Ear Earbuds Launch at 99 Dollars With Titanium Wire and LDAC
items.summary: Nothing's budget sub-brand CMF entered the clip-on open-ear category with the Clip Pro, priced at 99 dollars in the US, UK and Japan from August 15 and in Europe from September 15. The 5.9g buds use a titanium wire bridge, a 10.8mm dual-magnet driver, Hi-Res LDAC, a rotating Smart Dial on the case and up to 32.5 hours total battery life.

items.title: Sonova Announces Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 With Replaceable Battery
items.summary: Sennheiser parent Sonova unveiled the Momentum True Wireless 5 on September 3, built on the Snapdragon Sound platform with Bluetooth 6, Google and Microsoft fast pair, multipoint and a selectable robust RF mode. The earbuds add a user-replaceable battery for longer life, 12 hours playback per charge and ship at 299.95 dollars.

items.title: HIFIMAN Puts R-2R Ladder DAC Inside 299 Dollar Svanar Wireless 2 Earbuds
items.summary: HIFIMAN announced the Svanar Wireless 2 on September 2, a 299 dollar true wireless earbud built around its HYMALAYA Mini R-2R resistor-ladder DAC chip for audiophile-grade conversion in an in-ear form. The 7.4g buds add Bluetooth 6.0 with LDAC and L2HC, ANC to minus 35dB and IPX5 water resistance.

items.title: Samsung Announces Galaxy Buds 4 and Buds 4 Pro at Unpacked 2026 With Galaxy AI
items.summary: Samsung introduced the Galaxy Buds 4 and Buds 4 Pro at Unpacked 2026 as AI-focused wireless earbuds for the Galaxy ecosystem, with adaptive sound, upgraded ANC, two-way speakers on the Pro and deeper Galaxy AI integration for translation and calls. The Pro model carries a 24-bit Hi-Res codec and launched alongside Samsung's new foldables.
